journeys.name: Model and re-open accepted product truth
journeys.outcome: Create or import a stable product with accepted typed intent, persist it, restart/reopen, and recover the same product/baseline without identity drift.

journeys.name: Bind evidence and derive truthful dissatisfaction
journeys.outcome: Record scoped attributable evidence against accepted intent, derive truthful assessment, and surface an explainable missing/stale/failed/contradictory state without false green.

journeys.name: Navigate intent to engineering evidence
journeys.outcome: Starting from accepted product intent, boundedly navigate to linked engineering artifacts/evidence and back to the obligations they support.

journeys.name: Resolve externally and re-verify
journeys.outcome: Reference resolution work owned outside Tracera, observe work completion without accepting the product, then ingest qualifying proof and reassess.

journeys.name: Understand what partial Tracera actually is
journeys.outcome: Inspect mature completeness, stage readiness, journey/feature closure, shape and transition debt without reducing them to one percent.

journeys.name: Change accepted product contract with historical continuity
journeys.outcome: Propose and accept a contract change, preserve prior baseline/history, report scope delta, invalidate/re-evaluate affected proof, and query both old and new states.

journeys.name: Use equivalent human and agent product semantics
journeys.outcome: Inspect the same canonical product/finding through human and machine surfaces with matching identities/status semantics and enforced mutation authority.

journeys.name: Use derived knowledge without corrupting product truth
journeys.outcome: Distill/source knowledge with provenance, use it for navigation/proposals, and keep accepted intent unchanged until explicit acceptance.

journeys.name: Migrate and recover canonical product state
journeys.outcome: Upgrade a populated supported deployment while preserving identities/relations/evidence and demonstrate documented recovery.

journeys.name: Explain change impact
journeys.outcome: Given a changed obligation/artifact, identify bounded affected entities and show the trace paths supporting the impact.

journeys.name: Project canonical status to registry
journeys.outcome: Publish a revision-bound summary to PhenoRegistry without duplicating or overriding repo-local product truth.

journeys.name: Traverse one product across structural scales and projections
journeys.outcome: Start from a product, boundedly expand/collapse typed structure, switch among accepted projections, and retain canonical identity/declared partiality throughout.

journeys.name: Assess one exact product configuration without truth leakage
journeys.outcome: Select an exact version/variant/platform/deployment configuration, inspect applicable obligations/evidence/findings, and keep other configurations from affecting the result.

journeys.name: Discover and explain product dissatisfaction beyond test coverage
journeys.outcome: Surface attributable bugs, missing capabilities, performance/usability/structural gaps, while keeping predictive findings explicitly uncertain.

journeys.name: Import external product knowledge without corrupting canonical truth
journeys.outcome: Import supported external product/evidence artifacts with provenance, aliases and conflicts, link broad asset types, and export a fidelity-declared projection.

journeys.name: Collaboratively change product truth under explicit authority
journeys.outcome: Create concurrent human/agent proposals, detect conflict, and accept an authorized reconciled change without generated content self-authorizing mutation.

journeys.name: Use equivalent secure machine interfaces
journeys.outcome: Use supported machine surfaces with semantic parity, bounded pagination/version discovery and enforced authority against untrusted content.

journeys.name: Recover canonical truth across failure and concurrency
journeys.outcome: Perform canonical changes, concurrency/conflict, crash/restart and backup/restore while preserving coherent accepted history.

journeys.name: Operate at scale without semantic degradation
journeys.outcome: Use large product graphs/inventories under benchmarked scale, explicit partiality and stable continuation without false absence.

journeys.name: Use optional integrations without coupling core truth
journeys.outcome: Enable/disable/fail external adapters while preserving local truth and source provenance.

journeys.name: Federate work and registry projections without authority inversion
journeys.outcome: Exchange versioned AgilePlus evidence and PhenoRegistry summaries while repo-local Tracera remains product authority.
